{{nihongo|'''Mount Yudono'''|湯殿山|''Yudono-san''}} is one of the [[Three Mountains of Dewa]] in the ancient province of [[Dewa province|Dewa]] (modern-day [[Yamagata Prefecture]]). The [[Yudonosan Shrine]], the most holy of the Dewa Sanzan shrines, is located on the mountain.<ref name=":02">{{Cite web|last=山形県観光物産協会|first=公益社団法人|title=Yudonosan Shrine｜What to See & Do｜STAY YAMAGATA|url=https://yamagatakanko.com/en/attractions/detail_1339.html|access-date=2023-04-07|website=STAY YAMAGATA|language=en}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=ORGANIZATION|first=TOHOKU TOURISM PROMOTION|title=Yudonosan Shrine｜Search Destinations in Tohoku {{!}} TRAVEL TO TOHOKU - The official tourism website of Tohoku, Japan|url=https://www.tohokukanko.jp/en/attractions/detail_1623.html|access-date=2023-04-07|website=The official tourism website of Tohoku, Japan "TRAVEL TO TOHOKU"|language=en}}</ref>

Pilgrims have to enter the shrine itself barefoot, and photography is not allowed. Due to heavy winter snowfall, the mountain and shrine are inaccessible for long periods of the year.
